items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we were twin brothers... We organized the Jazztet and it just didn't happen... I would still use him when I could... I used him on record dates.

ctx.x: Could you talk about Addison please?
Addison, yes well, we were twin brothers. I was born one hour in front of him, and he was larger than me, a bit. And we were very close.
So, you were fraternal twins? As opposed to identical twins?
